business_problem: Nasdaq needed an enterprise AI platform that could search and retrieve business data quickly and accurately for internal and external use cases, but slow embeddings, high latency, rising costs, and accuracy issues limited adoption in a performance-sensitive financial environment.
solution_summary: Nasdaq modernized its AI platform with NVIDIA NeMo Retriever, NVIDIA NIM, and NVIDIA AI Enterprise to improve how employees and applications retrieve business and regulatory information. NeMo Retriever connects custom models to diverse enterprise data and generates higher-quality embeddings for chatbots and conversational interfaces, while NIM simplifies model deployment and exposes real-time performance feedback so the team can spot indexing and response issues quickly. Nasdaq also moved to self-hosted GPU embeddings and NVIDIA L40 GPU-backed infrastructure to speed up retrieval and lower costs in high-volume workloads. The platform was validated through four global hackathons that exercised coders and non-coders, shaping features such as API-based chat, no-code data connectivity, and broader tool integrations. Together, the stack creates a scalable retrieval platform that serves users across Nasdaq's financial-data ecosystem while remaining fast, predictable, and secure.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA NeMo Retriever
solution_components.role: Creates enterprise-grade retrieval and embedding services that connect Nasdaq's custom models to business data.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA NIM
solution_components.role: Optimizes deployment, monitoring, and scaling of the platform's AI models.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA AI Enterprise
solution_components.role: Provides the subscription model and software foundation that make costs predictable for Nasdaq's rollout.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA L40 GPUs
solution_components.role: Supply the GPU capacity used for large-volume retrieval and embedding tasks.

data_flow: Enterprise and business data is embedded through NeMo Retriever, NIM serves the AI models and surfaces performance insights, users access chatbots or other conversational interfaces through the platform, and the resulting interactions feed back into live indexing and feature prioritization across Nasdaq's internal and external AI products.
business_outcome: Nasdaq improved response times by 30 percent, increased conversational accuracy by 30 percent, reduced long-term costs with self-hosted GPU embeddings and AI Enterprise pricing, and expanded adoption through hackathons that turned the platform into a daily workflow tool across the company.
